rows.grounds: compound of homa, tarpana, bheda, and aṃśa with enclitic ca; sandhi in aṃśca
compound of phala and bheda with tas suffix

items.question: Which homa tarpana portions and yantras are distinguished according to fruit differences?
premises: Homa and tarpana portions are distinguished.
items.inference: The verse groups homa-tarpana portions and yantras under fruit-based differentiation.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of ca and case of aṃśa are not recoverable from the isolated verse.
items.plain_english: And the portions of homa and tarpana, and yantras, according to differences of fruit.
